python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
root=Path.cwd()
report=root/'artifacts/c5_excess_two_e5/REPORT.md'
newfiles=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines()
assert len(newfiles)==7, newfiles
assert set(newfiles)=={
 'artifacts/c5_excess_two_e5/REPORT.md','artifacts/c5_excess_two_e5/controls.json',
 'artifacts/c5_excess_two_e5/local.json','artifacts/c5_excess_two_e5/branches.json',
 'scripts/c5_excess_two_e5_controls.py','scripts/c5_excess_two_e5_local.py',
 'scripts/c5_excess_two_e5_branches.py'}
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()=='2ac279b6144cdfcf4ececd7b72f5d287a6f4b4ac'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],text=True).strip()
for rel in newfiles:
 text=(root/rel).read_text()
 assert text.endswith('\n')
 assert all(line.rstrip()==line for line in text.splitlines()), rel
for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',report.read_text()):
 path=target.split('#')[0]
 if path and path!='validation.json':assert (report.parent/path).exists(), target
for name,key in [('controls.json','source_sha256'),('branches.json','sources_sha256')]:
 data=json.loads((report.parent/name).read_text())
 for rel,digest in data[key].items():
  assert hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest, rel
local=json.loads((report.parent/'local.json').read_text())
for item in local['inputs']:
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'new_files_count':len(newfiles),'tracked_modifications':[], 'HEAD_unchanged':True,'whitespace_pass':True,'local_link_targets_pass':True,'all_certificate_source_hashes_match':True},sort_keys=True))
PY
